model.transform: per-source rank-match to the same-format FantasyCalc value curve (FantasyCalc itself uses raw values)

sources.name: fantasycalc
sources.tos: Public JSON API, no terms restriction found (api.fantasycalc.com, used as the existing app does).

sources.name: dynasty-daddy
sources.tos: No Terms of Use page; the Help Center documents a public no-key API: "Please cache responses and don't hammer the servers." robots.txt allows all.

sources.name: dynastyprocess
sources.tos: Open data repository file (files/values.csv, db_playerids.csv). Derived from FantasyPros ECR, so weighted below the trade markets.

sources.name: sleeper-adp
sources.tos: Sleeper public projections endpoint, adp_dynasty_* keys (real dynasty ADP). adp_dd_ppr from the brief does not exist in the response.

sources.name: keeptradecut
sources.tos: Excluded. https://keeptradecut.com/terms-and-conditions: "Any form of automated data collection, including but not limited to: Web scraping" is prohibited.

sources.name: fantasypros
sources.tos: Excluded. https://www.fantasypros.com/about/legal/: "you may not copy, reproduce, modify, republish, upload, post, transmit, or distribute any documents" without written permission; no scraping carve-out. robots.txt Crawl-delay 5.
